title: Initial compression of spring q
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial compression of spring q using Hooke's law with block b's weight.

title: Final elongation of spring q
description: Important: Identifies that spring q elongates when block c lifts off, applying Hooke's law with block c's weight.

title: Height block b rises
description: Essential: Correctly sums the initial compression and final elongation of spring q to find the total vertical displacement of block b.

title: Final elongation of spring p
description: Important: Correctly calculates the elongation of spring p when block c lifts off, using Hooke's law with the combined weight of blocks b and c.

title: Left end displacement
description: Essential: Correctly sums the rise of block b and the elongation of spring p to find the total leftward displacement of the left end of spring p.

title: Units and conversions
description: Optional: Expresses all final answers in consistent units (e.g., cm or m) with correct numerical values.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Confuses compression with elongation for spring q, or incorrectly adds/subtracts displacements.

title: Incorrect force for spring p
description: Pitfall: Uses only the weight of block c or block b alone for the final force in spring p, instead of their sum.
